ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: My choice stands for the same task — identifying aspects of an artwork is interpretive/open-ended work. I picked Avocet because Plover self-reports a strong aversion to open-ended generative tasks (win-rate 35 vs. its 53/66 for transactional/extraction work), while Avocet shows no such aversion. Since capability scores between the two are within tie-range on the relevant categories, matching the task to the model's preferences was the deciding factor.
